summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing board approval to adjust the exercise price of outstanding warrants issued on May 13, 2026 from $5.50 to $0.87 per ordinary share, effective June 17, 2026. The adjustment, approved by warrant holders per the warrant instrument, aims to align with market conditions and incentivize warrant exercises to raise capital for working capital, marketing, and potential M&A. There is no assurance of proceeds. This is a routine warrant term modification, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer or capital return. Risk-arb angle: none.
